{{2020–21 Northeast Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2020–21 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Central Connecticut State University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Devils are led by fifth-year head coach [[Donyell Marshall]], and play their home games at the [[William H. Detrick Gymnasium]] in [[New Britain, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Northeast Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2019–20 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]], 4–27, 3–15 in NEC play to finish in last place. They failed to qualify for the [[2020 Northeast Conference men's basketball tournament|NEC tournament]].
